entries.reason: ROLLOPS_PLUGIN_PUBLIC_KEY is operator configuration, not attacker-controlled input. VerifyArtifact reads it as the path to the cosign public key used to verify plugin signatures; whoever can set the process environment can already read any file the process can, so treating it as a path-traversal source assumes a threat model in which the attack is already unnecessary. Same shape as a --config flag. Fingerprint taken from the CI nox-results artifact, not a local scan — they differ. Re-verify if this path ever becomes settable from a request, a plugin manifest, or any other non-operator source.
